summary: Nora can now put a map in a document: she names the places and the system looks up where each one is. A person's home or position cannot be put on a map, and a place that cannot be found is refused by name so she can fix it.
details: She never sees or writes a coordinate. When she reads a document back, the map's coordinates are left out.
Each place name is one lookup on the maps service when a document is saved.
limitations: No route line is drawn between places, only the places themselves.
If the maps service is off or down, a document with a map is not saved and she is told so.
Every save looks the place names up again.
